articles.title: Manipur: Kuki chiefs oppose proposed IRB headquarters in Tengnoupal
articles.description: The Kuki Chiefs Association has opposed the proposed 11th India Reserve Battalion headquarters at Saivom village in Tengnoupal. It said the tender was issued without local consultation and insisted the project wait until peace returns.

articles.title: Pune: NCP-SP Demands Scrapping Of PMC’s Water Hyacinth Tender; Supriya Sule Targets Govt Over Potholes
articles.description: The issue gained fresh political traction after allegations in June that PMC had spent ₹7.97 crore on mechanical water-hyacinth removal over four years, while opposition leaders claimed the actual expenditure was around ₹16.61 crore and sought verification of payments to contractors
